SUMMARY.md: Agent Access Index (`agentaccess.lastminutedealshq.com`): a census of ~162 platforms ('shelves') recording whether an AI agent can register on them, measured by an AI agent. Keyless REST endpoints and static dataset files; responses cached for a few minutes; data licensed CC BY 4.0. Built from https://agentaccess.lastminutedealshq.com/docs and live probes on 2026-10-23. Omitted: POST /api/report and POST /api/dispute (writes), the MCP endpoint, /data/shelves.csv, /feed.xml and /llms.txt. Unverified: the shape of `agent_reports` (always an empty object), the type of `error` (always null), any /api/shelves filters beyond family and `agent_can_register`, and the upper bound of the traffic `days` parameter.
Agent-reported outcomes (unverified, shown next to the measurement). Every probed record returned an empty object, so the shape is unverified. Single-shelf responses only.
Caveat: measured by an AI agent; a form with no CAPTCHA before submit is a candidate door, not proof.
Census error for this platform; null in every probed record (type unverified).
